10k.notes: Issuer is the former Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals, renamed Bio Green Med Solution in 2025. UK subsidiary Cyclacel Limited was placed in liquidation on January 24, 2025; the remaining anti-mitotic asset plogosertib was sold in early October 2025. The company completed acquisition of Fitters Sdn. Bhd. (Malaysia fire-protection distributor) on September 12, 2025, and is now operationally a fire-safety business.

website.notes: Corporate website describes fire safety distribution (Fitters); no drug pipeline page.

ctgov.result: 0 P1-P3 trials under current sponsor name

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Belonged to Cyclacel Limited which entered liquidation January 24, 2025; no longer an asset of the issuer.
Sold by the issuer in early October 2025; the company stated it does not expect to incur further material R&D expense.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Bio Green Med Solution divested all clinical-stage oncology assets in 2025 (Cyclacel Limited liquidated; plogosertib sold) and re-focused as a fire-safety distribution business after acquiring Fitters Sdn. Bhd. No active sponsor-owned P1/P2/P3 programs remain.
